chunks: We built the heavens by Our authority; and We are the Lord of power and expanse.

key_terms.بِأَيْدٍ: By hands, meaning by power and might
key_terms.لَمُوسِعُونَ: We are the expanders, indicating vastness and power

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'bi-aydin' mean in the context of the creation of the heavens?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'bi-aydin' (with might/hands) is often interpreted not merely as physical strength but as divine capability and direct agency, distinguishing Allah's creation from human effort. The attribute 'al-musi'un' (the Expander) is linked to both the physical expansion of the universe and the spiritual capacity of the Divine to provide sustenance and grace to creation. This verse serves as a foundational proof for the infinite nature of God's power and the dynamic, non-static nature of the cosmos.
